title: A CHOIR BUILT FROM ONE BREATH

breath3.note: half a second of unpitched air (periodicity 0.53, centre 3710 Hz) standing 24 dB above what comes before

test.label: THE TEST
test.say: The defining passage: eight bars with the mechanism in it.

control.label: THE CONTROL
control.say: The same eight bars with the one thing taken out or scrambled. If this works as well, the idea failed.

song.label: THE SONG
song.say: A choir built from one breath: long-cycle vocal harmony.
